capabilities: set fallback default theme and mode
configure mappings in the plugin settings
extras: Can be installed early via BRAT before public listing; no screenshots appear in the README despite a Preview heading.
intentEvidence: Automatically switch Obsidian themes based on the folder of the opened note.
problem: Obsidian applies one theme to the whole vault, so users who want different looks for different note collections must switch themes manually.
summary: Theme switcher that automatically applies a chosen theme and light/dark mode based on the folder of the opened note.
